LightningComponentBundle.description: Fires standard Salesforce toasts in Screen Flows with auto-advance and sound support.

property.name: title
property.label: Toast Title
property.description: Header or title of the toast notification

property.name: message
property.label: Toast Message
property.description: Main message body (supports {0} placeholder if URL is provided)

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: Salesforce record ID to navigate to

property.name: autoAdvance
property.label: Auto-Advance Flow
property.description: Automatically move to the next screen or finish without user clicking Next

property.name: soundType
property.label: Sound Type (chime, success, bell, warning, error)
